name: Genex Love
source:
In a world full of "gifted" people, you are a young boy who's life dream was to become a Hero, but sadly, you don't have any ability. But everything will change when your "Genex" shows up!. Embark in this journey of "Becoming a Hero" (Or maybe a Villain?) while at the same time discovering more about your "ability" , dating beautiful girls, surviving the school, and who knows... Maybe more.

[From [url=https://rebootlove.itch.io/genex-love]Itch.io[/url]]
